items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: He didn't want to come back on the stand anymore, Liza -- and the tempo was (clapping).

ctx.x: I knew Kermit very well. But just to show you, though, you don't disrespect and you can't judge a book by its cover. Just respect people. You get along better. Nobody get that big, but he got big with (inaudible) run him off his own job. He didn't want to come back on the stand anymore, Liza -- and the tempo was (clapping).
Who moved up a step, the piano player or -- or Earl?
